items.title: The pushforward along a closed immersion is fully faithful, with essential image described by support
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The proposition describes the pushforward along a closed immersion: it is fully faithful on sheaves of sets with essential image the sheaves whose restriction to the complement is a singleton, and fully faithful on abelian sheaves with essential image the sheaves supported in Z, the inverse image being a left inverse in both cases (statement lines 6701-6727). The proof treats the case of sheaves of sets first, using the description of a sheaf on X_etale by its restrictions to Z and to the complement (proof lines 6729-6740), and then the abelian case through the notion of support (proof lines 6740-6750), which also yields the statement about the inverse image. The non-formal content is the description of the essential image in both settings. The claim is H2: two parallel arguments, both written out.
